resources.string: MilO logs your business driving by itself
Every drive in your truck, saved as Business or Personal, and the monthly report for your accountant.
How a trip starts and ends

When your phone connects to the truck\'s Bluetooth, a trip starts by itself and MilO records the drive with GPS. It ends when the truck disconnects, or once the truck has stood still for a while. You can also press Start trip and End trip yourself.
Trips in your work hours are saved as Business, the others as Personal. You set the hours in Settings, and you can change any trip on the Trips screen.
From the 1st, MilO reminds you to send last month\'s report. It opens your email app with the PDF attached, and you press send.
Your trips stay on this phone
MilO has no account and no server. Your trips leave the phone only in files you send or save yourself, and in your own Android backup.
Setup asks for the permissions MilO needs and pairs your truck. Then Settings, for your work hours, your name and the accountant\'s email address.
